decisions.reason: The substantial investment in the two-component resin injection unit and its public launch justify continued commitment despite limited recent online visibility.
As with Product A, the sunk costs and public commitment to the second two-component resin injection unit lead management to persist rather than withdraw.
The automatic airless spray gun is central to the announced coating equipment range, and the resources already invested make dropping it unlikely.
The manual spray gun benefits from shared development costs and a public launch, so escalation of commitment favors keeping it on the market.
The air-assisted model leverages existing airless technology and public commitment, so management is inclined to persist with it.
Although the data logger received less visible support after 2018, prior investment and the need to justify the launch still argue for keeping it, albeit with a somewhat higher drop probability.
